reused_source.authority: Existing finite graph model reused unchanged; local Bench session, not remote control of another instrument window

contract.source_state: Index in the existing directed(graph) order, initially edge 0→1
contract.branch_rule: At incoming (a,b), use existing transition(graph,index).allowed; order targets numerically. C selects the lower, D the higher allowed target.
contract.commit: Click accepts exactly one non-backtracking transition and records from/to indices, edges, branch and revision
contract.reverse_control: Proposes (b,a), records BLOCK without changing current edge or last committed projection witness
contract.restart: Explicit new local session at edge 0→1, not an inverse Return
contract.read_channel: Visual 1 READ 3 consumes selected typed C5 or G(10,2) witness. G(10,2) is selected by default; missing cubic source clears grids and produces HOLD without C5 fallback.
contract.tesa: Existing declared 28-cell display formula uses the latest committed cubic transition, or the initial ready pair. A rejected reverse does not advance this basis. This is a non-invertible display projection, not native graph topology.
contract.separate_reads: P/A and their existing C5-based display sectors stay unchanged when cubic edges move. Prime/state and native Blue/Dodeca body records are not overwritten.

tests.reverse_controls: All directed states; current edge and last committed witness preserved
tests.integration: Actual cubic and Visual1 controllers mounted in DOM doubles, source switching, numeric vertex IDs above 4 retained, missing-source HOLD, journal limit
tests.scope: Bounded software engineering acceptance, not a scientific run, replay of Lab evidence or browser pixel QA
